status: PROPOSAL — staged. Erik closes a hole I opened: workers must not be safe.

theHoleIOpened.what: My `engages` proposal gives stillhold 0.15, numinous 0.4, veilwright 0.4. Those figures almost never enter the engaged pool — so under the current two-population model (FIGHT or WORK) they are effectively IMMUNE. Nothing can reach a worker.
theHoleIOpened.whyThatIsBad: ⚠️ IT MAKES PACIFISM THE DOMINANT STRATEGY. A tradition that never fights takes no casualties, pushes steadily forever, and wins every long arc by attrition. That is not a peace tradition being rewarded for its virtue — that is an exploit wearing a virtue's clothes.
theHoleIOpened.eriksFix: 'darker traditions use stealth and assassination sometimes to target those safe back lines — and some lighter traditions crusade, or quest to destroy the same on the other side.' A THIRD ACTION. Correct, and it is the one the model was missing.

theThreeActions.FIGHT: engaged pool, weight-matched pairing. Decisive. Front-line vs front-line. (built — CCODE-115)
theThreeActions.WORK: steady modest push, no roll against a person. (built)
theThreeActions.STRIKE: ⚠️ NEW. Reaches PAST the enemy's engaged pool to hit a WORKER. Does not participate in the melee at all.

strikeMechanic.who: a figure with a `strikes` disposition > 0, drawn from the WORKING pool of their own side (a striker is not in the melee — that is the point)
strikeMechanic.target: a WORKER on the opposing side. Target selection differs by kind (below).
strikeMechanic.resolution: a real battleRound, but ASYMMETRIC — the target is not braced. Proposed: the striker rolls with advantage-equivalent, the target's weight counts at a fraction. This should be DANGEROUS to be on the receiving end of.
strikeMechanic.cost: ⚠️ MUST NOT BE FREE, or everyone strikes. Two different prices, by kind — see below. That asymmetry is the whole design.
strikeMechanic.frequency: rare. Proposed `strikeRate` ~0.08 baseline against engageRate's 0.35 — a strike is an EVENT, not a pass-by-pass action.

THE_QUIET_WORK.who: umbral · veilwright · abyssal · ashwarden (and unmaker at low rate)
THE_QUIET_WORK.targets: THE MOST VALUABLE WORKER — the highest-weight figure pushing unopposed. Efficiency: you kill the person who is actually moving the arc.
THE_QUIET_WORK.method: stealth. The target does not know it is coming.
THE_QUIET_WORK.cost: ⚠️ EXPOSURE, NOT INJURY. A failed strike does not wound the striker — it IDENTIFIES them. Proposed: a failed quiet strike marks the striker as known to the opposing side, which raises the rate at which they are targeted in return and can trigger a crusade against them specifically.
THE_QUIET_WORK.groundedIn: The crafts already say this is what they do: `the_never_there` moves through the most-watched place leaving NO TRACE, NO MEMORY, no evidence — and its bound is 'A VERITY-READER MAY FEEL THE ABSENCE ITSELF'. `quiet_step` r3 breaks a pursuit clean once per day. `the_false_target` draws aimed action to the wrong place. THE EXPOSURE COST IS THE CRAFTS' OWN BOUND, made into a world mechanic.

THE_CRUSADE.who: blazeborn · seraphic · verist · marcher (and radiant at low rate)
THE_CRUSADE.targets: THE MOST HATED WORKER — not the strongest, the one whose arc-position most offends them. Proposed selection: the enemy worker with the highest weight ON THE ARC THE CRUSADER MOST WANTS, i.e. the one doing the thing they cannot bear.
THE_CRUSADE.method: declared. The target KNOWS, and so does everyone else.
THE_CRUSADE.cost: ⚠️ COMMITMENT, NOT EXPOSURE. A crusader abandons their other arcs entirely for the duration — the attention budget goes to ZERO on everything else. So a crusade CREATES VACANCIES on the crusader's own side. That is the price, it is paid up front, and it is visible.
THE_CRUSADE.groundedIn: `radiance` r3 'reveals ALL that is hidden in a wide area' · `unshadow` r3 'nothing false can hold shape' · `ascent` r3 pronounces a judgment THAT BINDS — 'and IF YOU ARE WRONG, THE JUDGMENT BINDS ANYWAY'. A crusade that targets the wrong person is EXACTLY that bound at world scale, and it should be able to happen.

theSymmetryThatMakesItGood: ⚠️ SAME EFFECT, OPPOSITE METHOD, OPPOSITE PRICE. Both reach the back line and kill the person who was safely working. The assassin pays in EXPOSURE (a failure makes them a target). The crusader pays in COMMITMENT (a crusade empties their other fronts). Neither is cheaper; they are expensive in different currencies.

AND IT IS MORALLY EVEN, which the catalog has been consistent about all along. The crusade is not the clean version — a declared campaign to destroy someone who was tending a wood is not obviously better than a knife in the dark, and `ascent`'s own bound ('if you are wrong, the judgment binds anyway') says so.

IT ALSO FIXES THE VACANCY MECHANIC'S BEST CASE: `ws.arcVacancies` currently records seats abandoned by attention. A crusade creates vacancies DELIBERATELY — a narrator can now say 'the Burning Certainty left three fronts to hunt one man, and the poles moved while he was gone.' That is a world telling a story about itself.
whatItFixes: PACIFISM STOPS BEING DOMINANT. Stillhold still rarely fights — but they can be REACHED, and a tradition whose whole method is standing still is exactly who an assassin can find.

UMBRAL AND VEILWRIGHT GET A WORLD-SCALE ROLE. At engages 0.4-0.5 they were nearly invisible in the melee. Striking is what they are FOR, and it means the concealment traditions matter without ever winning a duel.

AND THE DEATH TABLE GAINS A SECOND AXIS: figures will die by TIER GAP (in the melee) and by BEING WORTH KILLING (in the back line). A high-weight worker is now the most dangerous thing to be — which is true of every real conflict and is currently not true here.
openForErik: Should a STRIKE be able to KILL, or only wound and remove-from-arc? My read: kill, rarely — an assassination that cannot kill is not one. But the death gate should stay in resolveEpicClash so there is one place that decides.

Should the player be able to BE struck this way, or is it legend-on-legend only? ⚠️ This is the big one: a party that parks a healer safely behind the line is exactly the back-line target the system now models. I lean YES, and it would be the sharpest consequence in the game.
Crusade duration — one pass, or until resolved? 'Until resolved' is better fiction and worse for the vacancy accounting. Probably a content dial.
